drifted.spec_text: Component MUST provide feature-gated telemetry that tracks total ops, min/max/mean latency, total bytes, and mean throughput. ... Feature-gated telemetry produces accurate TelemetrySnapshot values when enabled.
drifted.actual: Every call site passes a hardcoded literal 0 for latency_ns into TelemetryStats::record_op(), so min_latency_ns/max_latency_ns/mean_latency_ns are always 0 regardless of actual IO latency. InflightOp.start_ns is computed via Instant::now().elapsed() (elapsed time since a freshly-created Instant, i.e. always ~0ns) and is never read back to compute a real duration at completion time. Only total_ops, total_bytes, and mean_throughput_mbps are actually accurate; latency statistics are non-functional.

drifted.spec_text: Component MUST declare a receptacle for ILogger and log initialization at info level, operations at debug level, and channel disconnections at warn level.
drifted.actual: No `log.warn(...)` call exists anywhere in the crate (grep for "warn" across src/*.rs returns nothing), despite ILogger exposing a warn() method (components/interfaces/src/ilogger.rs:6). Client disconnection in the actor is logged at debug level (`actor: disconnecting client {client_id}`), not warn.
drifted.location: src/actor.rs:858 (should be warn per spec, is debug); no warn call exists in src/lib.rs or src/actor.rs

drifted.spec_text: Client callback channel disconnected: Logged at warn level, completion silently dropped.
drifted.actual: When a client's callback channel ring is full, the completion is not dropped and nothing is logged. Instead ClientSession::deliver() buffers the completion in a FIFO VecDeque (`pending`) and KernelHandler::poll_clients() retries delivery (flush_pending()) on every idle-loop iteration until it succeeds. This is an intentional, documented non-blocking-delivery improvement over the spec's described drop behavior, but the spec text does not reflect it and no warn-level log is emitted anywhere in this path.
